source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Switch' (PDF 9): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Switch devices ko jorta hai aur data sirf sahi device ko bhejta hai. Switch network ki speed aur efficiency (kam waqt mein zyada kaam) behtar karte hain. Aaj ke networks mein switch aam hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Switch ek samajhdar daakiye ki tarah hai: chitthi sirf usi ghar mein daalta hai jis ka pata likha hai, saare mohalle mein nahi baant'ta. Is liye baqi devices ka waqt zaya nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Switch network ki speed kaise behtar karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh data sirf usi device ko bhejta hai jis ke liye data hai, sab ko nahi; is liye faltu traffic kam hota hai.

items: Switch: ek network ke andar devices jorta hai aur data sirf sahi device ko bhejta hai.
